Journalist Files Contempt Plea Against Delhi Police, MHA

A journalist has filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court against the Union Home Ministry Secretary and the Delhi Police Commissioner. The petition alleges that the Delhi Police has acted in contempt of court. The Free Speech Collective has also moved the Supreme Court with a contempt plea against the Delhi Police and the Union Home Ministry. The journalist was reportedly detained twice.
